name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter Richter's journey into motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the precision engineering of Formula 1 cars. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from RWTH Aachen University before starting his career at a small engineering firm specializing in vehicle dynamics. After a decade honing his skills there, he transitioned to motorsport, working with various junior formula teams before finding a home at FVee Brasil. His approach to performance engineering is methodical and data-driven, always seeking marginal gains through meticulous analysis. He is known for his ability to quickly identify areas for improvement and implement effective solutions, even under immense pressure. Klaus-Dieter's experience with a wide range of race series makes him a valuable asset to any team.

His calm demeanor is something the young drivers appreciate as he is a good mentor. He is not afraid to get his hands dirty and is often seen tinkering with the car himself. He is a perfectionist, always striving for the best possible result. Despite his age, he still has the fire of passion in his eyes. He is eager to mentor the next generation of engineers.

physical.description: A tall, sturdy man with a serious but kind face, he is always wearing glasses.

quirks: Insists on using metric measurements exclusively, even when others are using imperial.
Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a peculiar habit of humming quietly while analyzing data.
